meta.note: canonical: first contact at mid-stance of the loaded right foot; the boot's line through the foot's sole centre
TIMING EARLY: first contact at 30 % of the right stance (the foot just loaded)
TIMING LATE: first contact at 70 % of the right stance (heel rising, unloading toward push-off)
LIGHT / GLANCING: the boot's line 0.16 m toward the toes (it passes across the toe box and the ball area)
STRONG: the boot's line 0.07 m behind the sole centre (heel / ankle: a direct sweep of the base of the stance leg)
